messages:
helen: Alert from paging: multiple SCIM provisioning requests returning 403 this morning after the backend role slug refactor. KMS DecryptFailure in logs.
omar: Which slug format did we switch to?
helen: We normalized roles to use tenant@namespace style (e.g., `alpha@admins`) to match new identity graph. Previously we used `tenant/admins` in externalId.
tia: That mismatch would cause the KMS metadata lookup to miss. The provisioner then calls decrypt with a nil key_ref -> DecryptFailure.
helen: Error sample: `2026-03-23T11:02:02Z provisioner ERROR: DecryptFailed user=svc-scim_1 err="invalid_ciphertext: empty_key_ref"`
omar: Can we confirm which customers are affected?
helen: Running quick SQL: `SELECT org, count(*) FROM scim_provisioning WHERE error LIKE '%DecryptFailed%' AND created_at > now()-interval '2 hours' GROUP BY org;` returns: greenfield-tech (12), nova-data (8), zetta-inc (3).
tia: Immediate options: 1) revert slug refactor in authz (high blast), 2) add a short-lived mapping layer in provisioner to accept both `@` and `/`, 3) backfill metadata keys for the new format pointing to existing envelope_id. I prefer safe path: deploy tolerant mapping then backfill.
helen: Agree. I'll prepare a canary patch to provisioner that normalizes incoming externalId by trying both variants before calling KMS. Add verbose (non-PII) logging showing incoming extid and matched metadata id.
omar: Important: when backfilling metadata rows, do NOT rewrap ciphertext. Copy the envelope_id pointer and annotate with migration_audit_id and author. Make the write idempotent.
helen: Opened runbook and ticket: ENGSEC-1905. Runbook link: https://confluence.internal/redwood/sec/idp-provisioning-migration (draft).
tia: For audit: ensure each successful migration emits an audit record with original_event_id and new_mapping_id so we can trace. Also add an eval to the replay queue to avoid duplicate downstream side-effects.
oncall-sre: I'll suppress the scim-kms alert for 90m while you canary.
kms-scan-bot: Suppression applied: scim-kms-decrypt -> 90 minutes.
helen: Canary deployed to prod with traffic routed to 10% of orgs. Observing metrics... initial 50 min: greenfield-tech failures dropped to 0 on canary subset.
omar: Run the backfill with a low qps (5/s) and verify audit entries. Also include a dry-run mode first to list what would be created.
helen: Dry run lists 23 candidate mappings. Proceeding with 5/s backfill. Progress: 23/23 created, 0 errors. Provisioning retries succeeded.
tia: Postmortem items: - add a contract test in CI that exercises identity mapping changes against provisioner- add a KMS-metadata existence check early and emit a distinct audit event- update deploy checklist: any idp/role-slug change requires cross-team signoff and migration plan
omar: I'll link ENGSEC-1905 to the CI tickets and schedule a follow-up demo for platform teams.
helen: Closing loop: will remove tolerant normalization shim after 7 days once no mismatches appear. Marking this thread resolved when post-checks complete. Thanks all :thumbsup:
